title: TestFullDatasetPerformance self-skips when data/kaggle is absent
evidence: internal/data/fullset_test.go:13 t.Skipf("full dataset not present"). In this archive data/kaggle/ IS present, so the test runs rather than skips, but the guard means the perf/coverage check can silently vanish on a workspace without the datasets.
suggestion: Point the test at the checked-in internal/data/testdata/ subset (always present) so the performance scenario is never skipped, or drop the Stat guard.
